input.summary: The inventory source feed is late. Nothing on our side is broken. For logical_date 2026-10-28, ingest_inventory found no file at landing/inventory/2026-10-28.csv. As designed, it logged a warning, loaded 0 rows and marked itself SUCCESS. raw.inventory_snapshots normally gets 100 rows a day (2026-10-18 through 10-27) and has none for 10-28. The two marts that read from it, mart.inventory_health and mart.sku_sell_through, are empty for that date too, which set off all three freshness alerts. No task failed and nothing was deployed in the last 72h, so a code change is ruled out. This matches a past postmortem where the inventory feed arrived late (an expired credential on the source's export job) and the runbook for late upstream data. No suspicious instruction-like text showed up in the tool output.
